meta.name: DRESS_LIST_CORE_LOOP
meta.status: PROXY / TEST — lean first pass for AKodMapLife
meta.coords: uu, centre origin (0,0) = map centre, x east, y north. z: floor = 0; main plateau +300; 'on cliff' = top of the KodCliffBlock proxy (greybox 500 uu).
meta.symmetry: every row is authored for P1 and rotated 180° about (0,0) for the AI side; instances carry side P1/P2
meta.collision_rule: ALL dress is visual-only: collision off, never affects navigation (KodMapLife already does NoCollision + SetCanEverAffectNavigation(false)). blocks:true = must look solid, so it must sit wholly on sim-blocked cells (KodCliffBlock / border / KodDestructible).
meta.density_unit: step_uu = spacing along a cliff line; per_1000x1000_uu = instances per 1000×1000 uu; or a count

global_exclusions.rule: no dress with any part within 2000 uu of any CC socket centre (all 7 bases)
no dress within 400 uu (2 cells) of any KodRoute centreline, unless its whole footprint sits on sim-blocked cells (it then can't intrude on the walkable path). Decals never exempt.
nothing inside the ramp rect or within 400 uu beyond either end along the run
≥200 uu from the vent plate bounds (the 1-cell no-build ring)
blocks:true rows only on sim-blocked cells
loose props on walkable floor ≤0.1 per 1000×1000 uu over the playable area (decals/FX excluded)

jadeite_standin.kind: resource visual (NOT scatter; attach to each KodResourceJadeite actor)

material.note: Child MI of the Obsidian monolith MI (glassiest of the biome variants), base colour / tint param set to jade. Param name: check the parent.

jadeite_standin.why: Tall, faceted standing-stone silhouette reads as a crystal shard when scaled down, unlike SM_GroundRock_* (round, and KodMapLife already scatters those as floor rocks, so it would be confused with dress).
jadeite_standin.source: /workspace/kod_paths.txt (full 4,997-path NAOMI scan). The 2026-10-12 md selection lists only Etherion BG_Cliff / Cliffside / effects, no small rocks.
jadeite_standin.art_call: Stand-in only. The real Jadeite crystal is Art's call.
